title: Platforms Overview
meta_description: Eight proprietary platforms — Nexus, Forge, Swarm, Sentinel, Twinverse, Quanta, Ledger, Compass — encoding a decade of deep-tech delivery into configura.

blocks.x: How platforms are used in engagements

Most programs combine two or three platforms: a decision program lands Nexus on Forge rails; an agentic program lands Swarm under Compass governance; an industrial program lands Twinverse with Sentinel segmentation. Each platform page carries Overview, Architecture & Trust and Industry Use Cases.
